name: Infected Love: The Fatal Experiment
source:
When a high school becomes a battleground for survival... In a zombie-infested apocalypse, saying 'I love you' becomes the most important thing!

Join us on a journey as a normal student who must team up with a unique group of friends to survive.

Uncover the truth behind the outbreak, build a stronghold in the abandoned school, and make crucial decisions that will lead you to 'love' or 'death'.

This is a story that will make your heart race... from both love and zombies!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972990/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当高中成为生存战场……在丧尸肆虐的末世中，说“我爱你”成为最重要的事情！

加入我们作为一名普通学生的旅程，他必须与一群独特的朋友合作才能生存。

揭开疫情背后的真相，在废弃的学校中建立据点，并做出将导致你走向“爱”或“死亡”的关键决定。

这是一个让你心跳加速的故事……来自爱情和僵尸！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972990/]Steam[/url]]
